heroTitle:
Live the journey.
Keep the memories.
heroBody: Your passport to the rainforest, its people, and a little piece of every adventure.
onePassport: One passport. Your entire Iguazú experience.
placeIntro: Start exploring with information from Visit Iguazú.
sourceNote: A Visit Iguazú listing does not imply a Passport partnership. Confirm hours, prices and availability with the provider.
passportBody: Collect stamps at participating places. Every visit is a new page.
emptyBody: Activate your passport and visit a participating place to collect its authorized QR stamp.
signInNote: Explore freely. Sign in when you want to save your experiences.
setup: Local discovery preview. The Supabase connection is not configured yet.
shareNote: Copy the link and share it through your usual channel. Pre-check-in links expire within 72 hours and can only be used once.
cameraFallback: Use your phone camera to open the QR, or enter its code.
scanNote: Stamps record visits. They do not award purchase points. If you just signed in, open the QR again.
routesBody: Explore the destination at your own pace.
routeEmpty: We are preparing the first routes with local providers.
rewardsBody: Rewards will arrive with pilot businesses. There are no benefits available to redeem yet.
hotelBody: Prepare for arrivals with your guests’ information ready.
pendingApproval: Profile pending approval as a partner.
noReservations: No reservations yet. Create the first one to issue an invitation.
precheckinBody: Enter your details using the reservation email. Your hotel will receive them to prepare for your arrival.
guestSuccessBody: The hotel received your information for review. Pre-check-in does not replace identity verification on arrival.
consent: I authorize the use of these details to prepare my hotel arrival.
privacyNote: No document photos are requested. These details are shared only with authorized hotel staff. The tourist passport and marketing communications are optional.
privacyBody: Passport and hotel data are kept separate. The pilot proposes deleting pre-check-in data 30 days after departure, subject to legal review and each hotel’s published policy. Marketing messages and document uploads are not enabled. Contact your hotel for access or deletion requests.

errors.not_configured: The connection is not configured yet. This action will be available once Supabase is connected.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot perform this operation.
errors.unavailable: Unable to complete this operation. Try again.
errors.invalid_invitation: The link or email is invalid. Ask your hotel for a new invitation.
errors.invalid_qr: This QR is unavailable. Ask the venue for help.
errors.already_claimed: This stamp is already in your passport.
errors.activate_first: Activate your passport before collecting a stamp.
errors.rate_limit: Wait one minute before trying again.
errors.limit: The available limit has been reached.
errors.invalid_state: The status changed. Refresh the page to continue.
errors.duplicate: This reference already exists. Check the reservation.

experience.sceneDescription: A miniature interpretation of the falls, surrounded by rainforest.
experience.sceneHint: A little glimpse of somewhere extraordinary.
experience.firstStampTitle: Your first stamp starts with a little exploring.
experience.firstStampBody: Simple, just like a holiday should be.
experience.stepExploreBody: Discover the destination and look for places participating in Passport.
experience.stepScanBody: When you visit a participating place, scan its authorized QR code.
experience.stepKeepBody: Your stamp stays in your passport. Your story continues at the next stop.
experience.sampleLabel: A page from your next journey
experience.sampleOnly: Just a preview. Real stamps come from visiting participating places.
experience.sampleInvite: A little preview of how your memories are kept.
experience.promoBody: A coffee, a walk, a new view of the rainforest. Turn visits to participating places into memories that travel with you.
experience.previewPassport: See what a stamp feels like
experience.stampCollected: A new memory in your passport!
experience.bookHint: Open it and try a sample stamp. Your real collection grows when you visit participating places.
experience.waterfallStory: A miniature inspired by the water, forest and mist of Iguazú. Move closer and explore this little landscape.
experience.collectedStory: This stamp belongs to your passport and holds the memory of a recorded visit.
experience.sampleDetailNote: Sample design. It does not verify a visit or imply that the place participates in Passport.
experience.recordDetailNote: This date is when the stamp was recorded in your passport.

directory.results: {count, plural, one {# place to explore} other {# places to explore}}
directory.sourceIntro: Attractions and agencies from the destination directory, together to help plan your next outing.

routeGuide.intro: Choose what draws you in. Explore at your own pace.
routeGuide.orderNote: Suggested order. Adjust stops to confirmed opening times, bookings and transport. You can spread them over separate outings.
routeGuide.disclaimer: Editorial ideas based on Visit Iguazú, not official tours or confirmed bookings.
routeGuide.stampNote: Stamps require an authorized QR at a participating place. Saving this route does not record a visit.
routeGuide.localNote: Saved only in this browser. No account needed.
routeGuide.storageError: We could not save this change in your browser. You can keep the link to this page.

falls.title: Follow the water
falls.subtitle: Three views of the falls
falls.body: Walkways, forest and Garganta del Diablo: a selection of walks inside the national park.
falls.tip: Check circuit access, park admission and train times before choosing your order.

wildlife.title: Birds and rainforest
wildlife.subtitle: Watch, listen, discover
wildlife.body: A hummingbird garden and a wildlife refuge offer two ways to discover the wildlife of Misiones.
wildlife.tip: Arrange the garden visit and the guided refuge tour. Confirm transport between the two places.

roots.title: The roots of Iguazú
roots.subtitle: Culture and local encounters
roots.body: Discover Guaraní culture and the farms of the 2000 Horizontes circuit on outings arranged with your hosts.
roots.tip: Book each experience separately. Ask each host about the activities available and how to get there.

adventure.title: Into the forest
adventure.subtitle: Adventure your way
adventure.body: Choose zip-lining, horseback activities or hiking at Mbocay, or plan separate outings to explore them.
adventure.tip: Confirm bookings, terrain conditions, activity requirements and transport with each operator.

rewardGuide.title: Your journey can keep giving.
rewardGuide.intro: We are preparing a space to discover benefits from local businesses and experiences. For now, choose what you would like to find.
rewardGuide.ticketTitle: Your next story is on its way
rewardGuide.ticketBody: Local benefits to accompany your time in Iguazú.
rewardGuide.ideasTitle: What would you like to discover?
rewardGuide.ideasBody: These proposals show the kinds of benefits we hope to develop with local operators. They are not confirmed offers.
rewardGuide.count: {count, plural, one {# saved interest} other {# saved interests}}
rewardGuide.termsPending: Provider, terms and availability to be defined.
rewardGuide.emptyBody: Explore the proposals and save your interests to find them here again.
rewardGuide.localNote: Your interests stay in this browser. They are not sent to businesses and do not reserve benefits.
rewardGuide.storageError: We could not save this change in your browser. Please try again.
rewardGuide.stepExploreBody: When benefits become available, you will be able to see who provides them.
rewardGuide.stepCheckBody: Each offer will show its requirements, validity and availability before you confirm.
rewardGuide.stepRedeemBody: Redemption will open when the program and its businesses are ready. No redemptions are active today.
rewardGuide.passportBody: Explore the destination and get to know your passport. Stamps record visits; they are not a spendable balance.
rewardGuide.faqStampsBody: No. Stamps record visits to participating places. They do not automatically grant points, discounts or money.
rewardGuide.faqWhenBody: There is no confirmed date yet. Benefits will be published once providers and terms are defined.
rewardGuide.faqInterests: Does saving an interest make a reservation?
rewardGuide.faqInterestsBody: No. It is a personal selection on this device. It does not create a reservation, subscription or request to a business.

flavors.title: Flavors of Iguazú
flavors.body: Food experiences to discover local flavors and enjoy a pause along your journey.

experiences.title: More experiences
experiences.body: Benefits linked to outings and activities to keep discovering Iguazú.

crafts.title: Made here
crafts.body: Ideas from local shops and makers for a memory to take home.

activeEmptyBody: Your passport is active. Visit a participating place and scan its authorized QR to collect your first stamp.
